Calculate the difference in revenue growth rates (percentage change) for Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) and United Parcel Service, Inc. (UPS) from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2024. What is the absolute difference in growth rates between the two companies?
answer: CAT revenue grew from $59.4 billion in 2022 to $68.0 billion in 2024, a growth rate of approximately 14.5%. UPS revenue decreased from $100.3 billion in 2022 to $91.0 billion in 2024, a decline of approximately 9.3%. The absolute difference in growth rates is 14.5% - (-9.3%) = 23.8 percentage points.
